messages:
marta: Heads up — PR #6412 (migration guide) contains real-looking customer emails in the examples. Legal flagged for redaction and requested signoff before merge. Also docs-preview shows a link-check failure.

jess: thanks. pinging @elaine (legal) and @sam (eng-security). can you confirm the redaction approach? also mark which lines to change.

ryan: can you paste the offending snippet here so we can patch quickly?

marta: snippet below:
```yaml
examples:
  - user: \"alice@example.com\"
  - user: \"bob@acme.co\"
  - note: \"Contact at support@real-customer.com for setup\"
```

jess: ok — we should not ship real domains/emails. legal usually prefers example.com/example.org or placeholder tokens like [email@example.com]. @elaine?

elaine (Legal): please do not use real customer domains or support addresses. Replace with user@example.com or user@example.org, or use <REDACTED_EMAIL>. Also file the redaction request form (https://internal.redwood/legal/redaction-form) so we have an audit trail. After form + new preview build, we can sign off.

docs-preview-bot: build #927 failed for PR 6412 — reason: link-check error at docs/migrate/6412.md -> broken relative link /guides/old-sdk

oli: I can fix the broken link and push a tiny patch. will also swap the emails to example.com.

marta: timeline — we need this merged today EOD. legal signoff required first.

jess: note: eng-security also wants us to run the docs-scrub tool to ensure no PII in history. @sam can you run or confirm?

sam (Eng Security): I can run the scrub. please give me the commit SHA and I'll queue the job. also prefer we remove emails entirely rather than redact in-place so history is cleaner.

marta: SHA: abcdef1 (latest on branch). scrub queued.

sam (Eng Security): scrub completed: no PII found in current branch, but there were emails in the diffs — confirm they've been replaced in the commit that oli will push.

oli: pushed changes in commit gh:bc1234 — replaced emails with user@example.com and updated the broken link to /guides/sdk-migration (relative). small lint fix too.

docs-preview-bot: build #928 triggered for PR 6412 — all checks passing (link-check OK, lint OK, preview generated)

elaine (Legal): redaction form submitted (ref: REDACT-2024-78). legal approves content as updated. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks everyone. once the preview is green and legal + eng-security are clear I'll merge. I'll also squash the branch to avoid leaking previous pulls.

deploy-bot: PR 6412 merged by jess at 2024-09-14T18:12:34Z

marta: huge thanks! please monitor for any downstream link redirects. if anything pops up I will follow up in this thread.

jess: merging done. will watch for errors in staging. :eyes:
